questions.question: The histogram shows the weights of students of class X in a school. Let x be the number of students whose weight is less than 50 kg and y be the number of the students whose weight is greater than or equal to 60 kg. What is the value of x : y?
questions.questionHtml:
The histogram shows the weights of students of class X in a school.

Let x be the number of students whose weight is less than 50 kg and y be the number of the students whose weight is greater than or equal to 60 kg. What is the value of x : y?
questions.solution:
Calculation:

Let x be the number of students whose weight is less than 50 kg = 20 + 45

⇒ 65

Let y be the number of students whose weight is greater than or equal to 60 kg = 40 + 5 

⇒ 45

Required ratio of x and y = 65 : 45

⇒ 13 : 9

∴ The value of x and y is 13 : 9

questions.question: Study the graph and answer the question that follows. The chart represents the demand and production of a certain item (in metric tonnes) for five companies U, V, X, Y and Z. If p% of the demand of the item for company U is equal to the production for company Z, then p is equal to:
questions.questionHtml:

The chart represents the demand and production of a certain item (in metric tonnes) for five companies U, V, X, Y and Z.

If p% of the demand of the item for company U is equal to the production for company Z, then p is equal to:
questions.solution:
Given:

Demand of company U = 6000

Production of company U = 3000

Demand of company V = 1000

Production of company V = 3500

Demand of company X = 5000

Production of company X = 2000

Demand of company Y = 2500

Production of company Y = 5500

Demand of company Z = 6500

Production of company Z = 4500

Calculation:

p% of the demand of the item for company U is equal to the production for company Z

Production of the company Z = 4500

⇒ p = 75

∴ The correct answer is 75.

questions.question: The given histogram shows the frequency distribution of the speed of cars passing though at a particular spot on a highway. Study the graph and answer the question that follows. The number of cars with speed between 70 km/h and 80 km/h is what percentage more than the number of the cars with speed between 50 km/h and 60 km/h? (correct to one decimal place)
questions.questionHtml:
The given histogram shows the frequency distribution of the speed of cars passing though at a particular spot on a highway. Study the graph and answer the question that follows.

 The number of cars with speed between 70 km/h and 80 km/h is what percentage more than the number of the cars with speed between 50 km/h and 60 km/h? (correct to one decimal place)
questions.solution:
Given:

The number of cars with speed between 70 - 80 km/h = 90

The number of cars with speed between 50 - 60 km/h = 70

Formula used:

Percentage increased = (greater value - smaller value)/smaller value × 100

Calculation:

Percentage increased = (greater value - smaller value)/smaller value × 100

⇒ Percentage increased = (90 - 70)/70 × 100

⇒ Percentage increased = 20/70 × 100

⇒ Percentage increased = 28.6%

∴ The percentage increase is 28.6%.
